scope: Pose-only finger repair: ordinary base curl from 60 to 90 degrees; the hash-guarded Arana Gymnast, Batty Brant and Black Cat Venom sources instead use measured per-digit source-relative closure with narrow per-hand overrides. Thumb opposition unchanged; the two original 2099 claw meshes use eased 65-degree distal flexion, others retain 85. Source hierarchy, bind, weights, proportions and materials retained. All suits have full offline regressions; native visual review is representative, not every suit. Native evidence is capped at two images per representative; a crop pair shows one pose, while runs without a crop show the two requested gameplay frames. No exhaustive finger/palm contact or all-catalogue acceptance is claimed.
